items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: That’s not Mel Powell, is it?

ctx.x: That’s not Mel Powell, is it?

Now we could play a little guessing game with someone — say how many people are here, right? So when you decided to put this one man recording together, it’s an interesting concept because the tunes are quite seasoned. Older tunes.
